verdict.rationale: Relay supports recurring financial automations like scheduled/percentage-based account transfers, recurring invoices, and automated approval rules, which count as recurring workflow scheduling within its banking domain. However there's no evidence of a general-purpose job/workflow scheduler, API/webhook triggers, or any AI-native automation surface for arbitrary tasks. Missing for 10: API-based scheduling, arbitrary workflow/job automation beyond money movement, AI-agent-facing scheduling interface.
